rule.name: SpringMultiWriteWithoutTransaction
rule.message: Put @Transactional on this method, or run its writes inside TransactionTemplate.execute. It writes to the database more than once outside a transaction, so when a later write fails the earlier ones stay committed.

property.name: xpath
